verdict.rationale: The only official, installable developer package in evidence is Meta's `llama-models` pip package. It is described mainly as a CLI for listing, downloading and verifying models and showing prompt formats ([llama-gh-1], [llama-gh-6], [llama-gh-4]), not as a full application SDK. Other build paths are runtimes such as ExecuTorch and llama.cpp, or the Hugging Face transformers format, rather than official SDKs ([llama-docs-13], [llama-docs-14], [llama-supp-weights-hf]). Probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented official client SDK (e.g. Python/TypeScript) for building inference or agent apps, SDK API reference docs, multi-language coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
